I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-random message. I confirmed that the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal is 100 seats and that I'll use that number, not the one in this morning's #north-team post.

As she asked, I took no other action and left the #north-team post alone. I offered to correct that post if she wants. It was fine to repeat the seat count in #north-random because seat counts aren't finance figures and Ilse posted the number there herself.
